name: short-pixel-optimizer/emr-tests
description: Test-only and lint-only dependencies for EMR. Kept separate from composer.json, which is the plugin/module build tool. Install with: COMPOSER=composer.tests.json composer install (writes composer.tests.lock, installs into vendor-tests/). bin/test.sh and the CI workflows do this automatically. Binaries land in vendor-tests/bin/ — phpunit and phpcs.
